text.tspan: Which of the following numbers CANNOT be spelt using the letters present in the image given below?
If a letter appears in the image, it can be repeatedly used any number of times to spell the number name.
letter in the picture. Letters hide inside other letters! Trace the lines
with your finger. Can you spot an F, an L, a V or an I hiding inside G, Y, T, H, E and R? Write
Take one option at a time and spell it: FIFTY, THIRTY, EIGHTY-FIVE, ELEVEN. Tick each letter
that is on your list. A letter can be used again and again.
Is there a name with a letter you cannot tick at all? That one CANNOT be spelt.
What will come in place of "?" in the given series?
the diamond in term 1 is 3. Look at the boxes: 1 and TWO, so 1 + 2 = 3. Is SEVEN in
term 2 also the sum of its two boxes? Check terms 3 and 4 too.

comes next, and which part is a digit and which a word? (2) Diamond value: the sum.
Has it been a digit or a word in turn? (3) Diamond place: below, above, below, above…
Check each option against all three rules. Cross out any option that breaks even one rule.
